verdict.rationale: Stripe supports event-driven automation via webhooks (reacting to events like disputes, payment successes) and has built-in automated actions like Smart Retries and revenue recovery, but there's no evidence of a general user-facing 'rules engine' where an AI-native user can declaratively define arbitrary trigger-condition-action rules; developers must write custom webhook handlers/code to react to events. missing for 10: a no-code/low-code rules-builder UI for defining custom event-triggered actions, evidence of conditional logic beyond fixed automations like retries/tax, and AI-agent-specific rule definition tooling.
